o.text: Borrowed from Classical Persian لوت (lūt, “naked, bare”).
Morphologically qazmaq (“to dig”) + -ıntı. Probably a calque of Russian ископаемое (iskopajemoje).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish یللنمك (yẹllenmek). By surface analysis, yellə- + -n.
Borrowed from Russian та́чка (táčka). Influenced by daşımaq.
